title: Cost Synthesis Orbit: cross-cycle initiative to standardize savings experiments and rollout
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Initiative to create a repeatable operating model and artifacts for cost-saving experiments across batching, KV cache strategies, and quantization paths. The goal is to reduce per-token unit cost while maintaining SLOs and predictable quality regressions control. Workstreams: 1) standardized experiment grid and gating, 2) econ scorecard and rollout criteria, 3) console/alerting hooks for live pilots, 4) cross-functional field lab with 3 pilot customers. This ticket tracks the PM-level plan, milestones, and coordination tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Econ scorecard defined with primary/secondary metrics (per-token cost, p50/p95 latency, quality delta) and validated on historical traffic
Experiment grid schema published and supported by console experiment runner
Three pilot experiments executed with instrumentation (batching policy, cache TTL variants, int8 weight quantization) and results summarized in scorecard
Runbook for safe rollback and automated fallback created and integrated into rollout policies
Two dashboards and one alerting policy live showing customer-level unit-econ and quality regressions
